customer_request: Demonstrate a case-routing workflow to a steering committee in ten working days.
stated_outcome: Reduce avoidable hand-offs without weakening decision authority or public-record controls.
facts: The sponsor can approve discovery activity but cannot approve production data access.
A security representative is available twice each week.
Only generated case records may be used in the learning environment.
visible_tensions: The sponsor describes the demonstration as production-ready in one email.
Operations wants a manual fallback; the product manager wants automation first.
known_boundaries: No access to council production systems or identities.
Legal and records-retention conclusions require authorised specialists.
learner_note: This is the learner-visible baseline. An assessor may add a controlled changed constraint during an observed exercise.
